Create a polished, emotionally powerful, competition-ready PowerPoint presentation for our project:

This presentation is for a hackathon / innovation competition and may be viewed by:
data-center companies, infrastructure companies, AI/ML companies, sustainability leaders, investors, technical judges, and non-technical judges.

The presentation must NOT feel like a college project, technical report, or research-paper presentation.

It should feel like a serious deep-tech / climate-tech product that was built to solve a real problem.

============================================================
THE CENTRAL STORY
============================================================

Build the entire presentation around one human idea:

"Computers are getting more powerful.
But the way we cool them is still largely reactive."

Every server is constantly doing something.

It is processing AI.
Serving users.
Running businesses.
Training models.
Moving data.

And while all of this happens, the infrastructure around it is consuming energy to keep those machines safe.

Traditional cooling often waits for thermal conditions to become visible before responding.

We asked a different question:

"What if the servers are already telling us that heat is coming?"

That question led to Thervo.

Thervo uses existing server telemetry such as CPU, GPU, memory, disk and network activity to understand changing workloads, infer thermal behavior, predict thermal risk, and support proactive cooling decisions without requiring additional physical temperature sensors.

And because an AI decision should not be a black box, Thervo also explains why cooling increased or decreased.

The story should therefore move naturally through:

PROBLEM
↓

↓
IDEA
↓
PRODUCT

FUTURE

The audience should finish the presentation thinking:

"Cooling shouldn't have to wait for heat."
